integrity: The proof and accompanying rational-arithmetic verifier are self-contained. Same-model verification is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to edge-uniform random greedy matching on a complete bipartite graph with one perfect matching deleted; the constant term beyond the logarithmic correction is not identified. Some early related full texts were inaccessible, so historical-priority risk remains.
title: Sharp rare failure of uniform-edge greedy matching on crown graphs
